content.title:
What would you do if you noticed the symptoms of measles? Measles is highly contagious and can be passed on via coughs and sneezes, which occur before a rash appears. The first symptoms of measles include a high temperature, a runny or blocked nose, sneezing, a cough, and red, sore, watery eyes.

If you notice measles symptoms, call your GP practice or 111 📲 

Two doses of the MMR vaccine can protect you and your family from becoming seriously unwell with measles 👪

If you have any questions about the MMR vaccine, speak to your GP practice for expert advice 🗨
